capabilities: Fold or unfold a line by long-pressing it
Step folding with the mouse wheel left of the text
Click left of the text to fold like the fold chevron
Keep the line under the mouse at the same screen height while folding
Fold all and unfold all from the view header
disambiguation: The generic name suggests a general editor patch, but the plugin only adds mouse-based folding to the editor.
extras: Desktop only; requires Obsidian's core 'Fold indent' and 'Fold heading' editor settings to be enabled. Settings and buttons are in English or Korean.
intentEvidence: Folding needs Obsidian's Fold indent and Fold heading settings (Settings → Editor) turned on.
problem: Obsidian's folding relies on small fold chevrons and keyboard movement, with no convenient mouse-based way to fold indented lines or headings.
summary: Mouse-driven folding for the editor: fold or unfold lines and their parents via long-press, clicks, or the wheel in the left margin.
